verdict.rationale: Typesense is API-first: the docs say the complete API surface ships in the open-source server, and Cloud lists 'Full API Access' alongside its Visual Dashboard. The Cloud MCP server lets an agent create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics, which suggests cluster management is also programmatic. However, no source states that everything in the dashboard can also be done through the API, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement, a documented Cloud management API covering dashboard actions (team access, RBAC, SSO), a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The complete API surface is available in the open-source server under GPL-3.0.
